subject: Abstractive Summarization
source_sentence: Another recent abstractive summarization method generates new sentences by selecting and merging phrases from the input documents.
title: Abstractive Multi-document Summarization with Semantic Infor- mation Extraction

subject: Optimization
source_sentence: An ILP optimization framework is used to simultaneously select and merge informative phrases to maximize the salience of phrases and meanwhile satisfy the sentence construction constraints.
title: Abstractive Multi-document Summarization with Semantic Infor- mation Extraction
